reason: An on-device macOS vision plugin that performs OCR and selected Apple Vision image detections on local images, clipboard content, screens, and application windows.

summaries.zh: 一款基于 macOS Apple Vision 的本地视觉插件，可对图片、剪贴板、屏幕和应用窗口执行 OCR 及图像检测。
summaries.en: A macOS plugin using Apple Vision to perform on-device OCR and image detection on local files, clipboard images, screens, and application windows.

capabilities: Reads local image files and clipboard images
Captures the screen, foreground window, or selected application windows when authorized
Performs on-device OCR and Apple Vision image detection
Returns structured text, confidence, coordinates, candidate results, and detection status
Builds and caches a native Swift helper on first visual task
